signInModal.linkExpired: Sign-in link expired or invalid. Try again.

account.title: Account
account.subtitle: Profile, sessions, and your movement data.
account.activityEmpty: No sessions yet. Try a mini app or Open Movement Viz.
account.leaderboardsEmpty: No scores yet. Finish a mini app, then opt in to post to the public board.
account.leaderboardsActivityOnly: Best scores from your Activity. These aren't on the public leaderboard until you opt in after a session.
account.insightsStatsOverTimeHint: Weekly averages measured from your tracked joints — range of motion and left/right symmetry.
account.insightsJointRomHint: Average peak joint range across all tracked sessions.
account.insightsMovementFocusHint: How often you trained each movement pattern.
account.proActiveHint: Open Movement Viz and video storage unlocked.
account.proGrandfatherHint: Pro access is active on your account.
account.proFreeHint: Upgrade for Studio, full overlays, clean exports, and video storage.
account.noVideoForSession: No video for this session. Analysis charts are still available
account.upgradeToStoreVideos: Upgrade to store videos with your sessions.

purchase.title: Purchase program
purchase.mockNote: Mock checkout — no charge. Creates a time-boxed entitlement in your account.

proPaywall.title: Mova Pro
proPaywall.subtitle: Unlock Open Movement Viz, full overlays, clean exports, and video storage.
proPaywall.featureStudio: Open Movement Viz — all motion overlays on any video
proPaywall.featureSessions: Save video with your sessions and reopen them later

partner.dashboardSubtitle: Submit programs for review. Mova admin handles video upload and exercise tagging.
partner.dashboardEmpty: No programs yet. Submit your first one below.
partner.newProgramSubtitle: Week-based structure only — admin will build sessions and upload videos.
partner.programSubmitted: Program submitted (mock). Admin will upload videos and publish when ready.
partner.fieldNotesPlaceholder: Outline weeks, exercise list, video links, or anything we should know…
partner.adminNote: You do not upload exercises here yet. Share links or notes — admin adds metadata and 1080p videos.
partner.gateBody: Switch to the partner tier in the mega menu (dev) or contact Mova to get access.
partner.gateDevHint: Dev: mega menu → Dev tier → Partner
partner.usageMockNote: Usage stats are mock data until Stripe Connect and Supabase are wired.
partner.reviewMockNote: Your program is in review. Admin will upload exercises and publish when ready.

coachStudio.title: Coach Studio
coachStudio.subtitle: Turn short movement clips into coach-ready instructional videos.
coachStudio.lockedBody: This workspace is for Coach accounts. Head back to the archive to keep training.
coachStudio.toolsTileSubtitle: Create instructional workout videos from short clips to share with clients.
coachStudio.signInRequired: Sign in to open Coach Studio and save drafts.
coachStudio.noDrafts: No drafts yet. Upload a short clip to start.
coachStudio.emptyHint: Upload a movement video (up to 30 seconds). We'll save a draft so you can come back and edit.
coachStudio.instructionsPlaceholder: Form cues, equipment, what to look for…
coachStudio.foundationNote: Editor timeline (freezes, captions, joint paths) comes next — this spike proves save/resume.
coachStudio.trackError: Motion tracking failed — lines may not render.
coachStudio.noFreezes: No freezes yet. Scrub the timeline and add one.
coachStudio.captionNeedsFreeze: Select or add a freeze first, then attach captions to it.
coachStudio.captionDragHint: Drag a caption on the video to position it.
coachStudio.captionLineLimit: Stops when a third line would wrap on the video.
coachStudio.selectFreezeHint: Select a freeze on the timeline to edit hold time and captions.
coachStudio.focusBodyPartHint: Soft glow on a joint during this hold or phase (not a segmentation mask).
coachStudio.holdOverlaysHint: Lines and focus that appear while this freeze is held.
coachStudio.phaseOverlaysHint: Lines and focus that appear during this phase of motion.
coachStudio.deleteFreezeConfirm: Delete this freeze? Neighboring phases merge, and phase overlays that depended on this freeze may be lost.
coachStudio.phaseDrawerHint: Captions and overlays for the motion between freezes.
coachStudio.angleChipsHint: Live joint angle (degrees) near the joint. Tap a chip to style it.
coachStudio.mobilityGeometryHint: Reference axes and joint angle arcs for this hold or phase.
coachStudio.exportHint: Renders your clip with lines, freezes, and captions burned in.
coachStudio.exportWaitTrack: Waiting for motion tracking to finish…
